title: Photak Marathon 2026 Review: Nong Khai's 6th-Edition Mekong Road Race
seo_title: Photak Marathon 6th Edition 2026 Review | Nong Khai Thailand
meta_description: The Photak Marathon (6th edition) 2026: December 13 in Pho Tak, Nong Khai, Thailand. Full marathon, half, 10K, and 5K, registration open at THB 350-1,000 -- a Mekong-side race, reviewed.
dek: Set for 13 December 2026 in Pho Tak, Nong Khai — the Mekong River province bordering Laos — this 6th-edition marathon offers four distances with registration open from just THB 350. One of Thailand's most affordable full marathons in one of its most distinctive regions.
verdict: The Photak Marathon (6th edition) is a small but established Isan road race in Pho Tak district, Nong Khai — the Mekong-side province that faces Laos across the river. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) and open registration from THB 350–1,000 make it one of the most affordable marathons on the Thai calendar. December in Nong Khai is cool and dry, and the Mekong River backdrop gives the course real character. Don't expect a slick, large-scale production — this is a regional race, not a tourism juggernaut — but for runners who want an authentic Isan marathon experience at an unbeatable price, it delivers.

sections.heading: The Setting: Pho Tak, Nong Khai — Mekong River Country
paragraphs: Nong Khai is Thailand's northeasternmost province, stretched along the Mekong River with Laos visible from the riverbank. [1] Pho Tak is a district west of Nong Khai city, and the race route is likely to feature rural roads, river views, and the flat terrain characteristic of the Mekong floodplain. December is Isan's cool, dry season — morning temperatures in the mid-teens Celsius, among Thailand's best running conditions.

sections.heading: Registration: THB 350–1,000
paragraphs: The entry fee is the headline: THB 350–1,000 for a full marathon, which is roughly USD 10–28. [1] At that price, it's one of the most accessible full marathons in Southeast Asia. Registration is currently open, making this a bookable option for the December 2026 calendar.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want an affordable, community-flavoured Isan marathon with cool-season conditions and a Mekong River backdrop, the Photak Marathon is a solid pick. The 6th edition is set for 13 December 2026 in Pho Tak, Nong Khai. [1]
